A replacement retained only for provenance is not a current claim of this study.

entries.manuscript_destination: P2 common-reference count/seed/block audit; Tables tab:p2seedcurve, tab:p2seedconfigs and tab:p2curve; P2-C06/C07/C10/C12 and P2-REV-COMMONREF
entries.interpretation: 27 fits with three computational seeds and three biological donors; shared-field and simple-control errors use the common held-donor-excluding reference. Block ranges are descriptive and two count levels do not identify a plateau.

entries.current_use: P2-REV-SOURCE-ABLATION retains the earlier matched mixed-source diagnostic at the original held-source particle counts. The 20260923 200-particle individual-versus-mixed audit is a separate comparison, not a replacement of these unchanged numbers.
entries.manuscript_destination: P2 source-information replacement sensitivity; P2-REV-SOURCE-ABLATION
entries.interpretation: Nine saved fields and 50 computational draws each, no new fits or independent donors. Source substitution reduces aggregate error but PWH27 favors real source, leaving consistent incremental source value unestablished.

entries.manuscript_destination: P2 Equation eq:p2mixture; Tables tab:p2mixtureidentity and tab:p2mixtureaudit; P2-MIXTURE-IDENTITY and P2-INDIVIDUAL-SOURCE
entries.interpretation: Exact target-marginal convexity identity and separate 200-particle individual-source/mixture sensitivity on three donors and nine saved fields. PWH28 real source beats either individual substitution but not their mixture. Equal-count individual-minus-mixture contrast is not the exact identity on actual mixture component subsets. No new training, independent donors, p values or confidence intervals; verified arithmetic does not establish incremental donor information.

entries.manuscript_destination: P2 Figure 4; tab:p2pairedclock; Methods/Results
entries.interpretation: Complete paired random-stream exact-time grid; centroid uses the same donor future day30, a retrospective interpolation task. The historical nearest-grid scan is separate. Seed ranges are not biological confidence intervals; no target-guided best clock is selected. This is not clinical validation and does not close the paired-method comparison.

entries.manuscript_destination: P2 Methods/Results; tab:p2observable; tab:p2decoderreference
entries.interpretation: Equal-cell common-panel mean expression against actual held-donor count-derived proportions, not decoded truth. These are not absolute counts and not biological confidence intervals. Decoder reconstruction is not a mathematical lower error bound. POP05 remains partially addressed; this is not clinical or external validation.
